# 汪家夫妻 EP4〈凌晨三點打電動〉

## 故事前提

凌晨三點，阿福戴著大耳機在沙發上打電動大叫；走廊盡頭敷著白面膜的珍珠慢慢歪頭。隔天早上，阿福被包成嬰兒躺在嬰兒床、含著奶嘴，頭上的吊鈴是一支支迷你遊戲手把。當天晚上打電動大叫的換成珍珠，阿福在嬰兒床裡聽著，吊鈴上的一支手把慢慢轉過來對著他。

## 角色

- 阿福（afu）、珍珠（zhenzhu）：同系列定裝照。

## 站主觀點

零台詞；集數規劃盲評 79（`docs/videos/wangjia-couple/episodes.md` 的 EP2）。採納評審建議：開頭加一秒指針時鐘指三點（只有刻度、沒有數字）、s06 珍珠腳邊也散一地零食空袋、s07 吊鈴上的迷你手把轉過來對著他。

## 格式

- 9:16，約 16 秒；Colab 首格與 H3 片段。

## 大綱

### 選項 A：凌晨三點打電動
一行說明：指針指三點 → 打電動大叫 → 走廊面膜歪頭 → 耳朵貼平 → 被包成嬰兒、手把吊鈴 → 當晚換老婆打 → 吊鈴的手把轉向他。
開場鉤子：一個只有刻度的時鐘，指針指著三點，藍光一閃一閃。

shots.ff: Insert close-up of a plain round wall clock with no numbers, only tick marks, its hour hand pointing at three and minute hand at the top, on a dark living room wall flickering with blue light from an off-screen TV.
shots.clip: The clock hands stay at three o'clock; blue TV light flickers across the wall and the clock face. The camera holds a static shot.

shots.ff: Medium shot of a dark living room at night: A-Fu the Corgi himself sits cross-legged on a grey sofa in his striped pyjamas wearing big over-ear headphones, holding a plain game controller with no logos, his face lit by blue light from an off-screen TV, crumpled empty snack bags with no labels scattered at his feet, mouth wide open yelling.
shots.clip: The Corgi shown in <Picture 1> mashes the controller buttons frantically, his whole body swinging left and right with the game, mouth wide open in a yell. The camera holds a static shot.

shots.ff: Wide shot of a dark hallway at night: at the far end Zhenzhu the Shiba herself stands motionless in a bedroom doorway, a bathrobe over her pink floral dress, a plain white sheet face mask covering her face, her two eyes reflecting faint blue light.
shots.clip: The Shiba shown in <Picture 1> stands perfectly still in the dark doorway, then very slowly tilts her head to one side. The camera holds a static shot.

shots.ff: Close-up of A-Fu the Corgi himself in big over-ear headphones, mouth still wide open, lit by blue TV light, thumbs on a plain game controller.
shots.clip: The Corgi shown in <Picture 1> stops pressing the buttons; his ears slowly flatten back one notch at a time; his eyes slowly slide toward the dark hallway at the left edge of the frame. His mouth stays open. The camera holds a static shot.

shots.ff: Wide shot of a sunny bedroom in the morning: A-Fu the Corgi himself is swaddled tightly in a pink baby blanket up to his neck, only his head showing, lying inside a white wooden baby crib, a pacifier in his mouth; above the crib hangs a baby mobile made of tiny toy game controllers with no buttons or logos.
shots.clip: The Corgi shown in <Picture 1> lies still, swaddled in the crib; the mobile of tiny toy controllers slowly turns above him; he blinks twice and the pacifier bobs twice. The camera holds a static shot.

shots.ff: Medium shot of the same dark living room sofa at night: Zhenzhu the Shiba herself sits cross-legged on the grey sofa in a bathrobe with a plain white sheet face mask, wearing big over-ear headphones, holding a plain game controller with no logos, lit by blue light from an off-screen TV, crumpled empty snack bags with no labels at her feet, mouth wide open yelling.
shots.clip: The Shiba shown in <Picture 1> mashes the controller buttons frantically, her whole body swinging left and right with the game, mouth wide open in a yell. The camera holds a static shot.

shots.ff: Close-up of A-Fu the Corgi himself swaddled in a pink baby blanket in a dark baby crib at night, a pacifier in his mouth, eyes wide open; one tiny toy game controller with no buttons or logos hangs from the mobile just above his face.
shots.clip: The Corgi shown in <Picture 1> lies awake listening; the tiny toy controller hanging above slowly turns to face him; he sucks the pacifier slowly twice. The camera holds a static shot.
